paper: AI Trading's Alpha Singularity: Emergent Market Reasoning through Agent-to-Agent Self-Evolution
claim_boundary: A researcher-authored monthly U.S.-stock analogue of AGORA's sealed five-role joint search over AlphaGen-style signals and evaluation metrics, culminating in a training-selected top-30 composite; not the missing LLM calls, 94 native programs, skill registries, PPO checkpoint, CSI1000 data, or actions.

primary_source_anchors.mechanism: Sealed Joint Search separates artifact producers, metric producers, adjudicators, persistent skill stores, and a fixed external evaluator through five structural conditions and three typed channels.
Agora instantiates five roles across nine isolated clients, eight skill libraries, role-scoped records, bounded cross-round briefs, and substrate-local promotion against training outcomes.
One hundred outer rounds produce 94 unique AlphaGen programs; the final strategy is the equal-weight z-score composite of the top 30 selected by training IC.

The metric library evolves through trial, accepted, and rejected states; monotonicity_score_v1 is proposed at round 21 and excess_drawdown_penalty_v1 at round 50 under empirical or adjudicated promotion.
An incremental MaskablePPO relay carries training-only proposal state across rounds while test statistics are excluded from its reward path.

search_policy.common_portfolio_adapter: the frozen top-30 equal-weight z-score composite enters fixed value-weighted long-short deciles and all six common paths

preserved_elements: joint search over alpha artifacts and evaluation metrics
approximated_elements: JKP characteristics replace CSI1000 OHLCV and AlphaGen tensors
deterministic role functions replace nine unavailable LLM clients
ranked symbolic formulas replace missing native AlphaGen programs
three deterministic score views replace evaluator narratives
feature proposal weights replace MaskablePPO network state
monthly deciles replace five-day next-open execution
the printed promoted-metric logic is adapted from daily equal-weight arrays to monthly common paths
all post-training common months are more strictly sealed than the paper's categorical test feedback
invented_elements: one new registry alpha per round until the 94-alpha cap
the PPO-relay decay and learning rate
the deterministic advisory and candidate-priority rules
the monthly implementations of metric correlation and promotion
